title: Summary update under appending a bit
statement: Encode a summary tag $0$ by the empty word, $1$ by the one-letter word $[\mathrm{true}]$, and $2$ by $[\mathrm{false}]$. Summarize a Boolean word as empty if it is empty, accepting if it is exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, and dead otherwise, with these three summaries coded by $0,1,2$, respectively. For every Boolean word $u$ and optional Boolean symbol $b$, the code of the summary of $u$ followed by $b$ (if present) equals the summary tag obtained from the code of the summary of $u$ and $b$.
